[Bring The Visual Feast To Your Life] Featuring a 1920 x 1200 resolution and a 16:9 aspect ratio, the 15.6'' Full HD Display of this business laptop delivers vibrant colors and sharp details like never before. Whether you are watching videos, using Office Excel, or browsing the web, you will have a splendid experience
